If someone has been here less than six months, how much paid parental leave do they get?

name: get_policy
content: {"ok": true, "id": "POL-PAR-01", "title": "Parental leave", "text": "Birth, adoptive and foster parents with at least 6 months of service get 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave, taken within 12 months of the child's arrival. Employees with less than 6 months of service get 6 weeks paid. Tell HR at least 30 days before the leave starts when possible."}
